little-world.jpg.origin: Original VORO gouache key art, generated for the product. The exact generation prompt is included below.
little-world.jpg.transformation: JPEG format conversion at quality 86, maximum dimension 1100px; no new artwork.
little-world.jpg.generationPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square key art for VORO, an indie game-development asset review app. Create a beautifully art-directed hand-painted gouache illustration, square composition, no text or letters. A small imaginary game world being lovingly made: a mossy apricot island with a tiny lilac mushroom-roof hut, coral crooked steps, one plump aubergine forest sprite with two floppy leaf ears and tiny cream eyes, a tall curved seedpod lamp, scattered butter-yellow stars and sculptural pebbles, a ribbon of pale turquoise water. A few foreground props look like charming handmade game assets. This is sophisticated indie game artbook artwork: confident broad brush strokes, pigment texture, imperfect painterly edges, tactile warm matte color, playful silhouettes, asymmetric composition with real negative space. Palette: muted plum #332a3c, apricot #ef9a79, pale lilac #dcd0e9, butter #f2d58d, sage #9dbba6 and warm off-white #f6f3ef. Background is flat pale lilac with subtle painterly pigment, not a gradient. Cozy, curious, a little weird; polished contemporary artist illustration. Whole island and all key subjects within frame with breathing room. Avoid technical grids, wireframes, UI chrome, logos, text, hyperreal 3D, glossy plastic, blue corporate style, neon, photorealism and stock vector look.
